topic: Write a Letter of Advice（给同学写一封建议信）
genre: 应用文 / 建议信（letter of advice）
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit1 Reading for Writing:write a letter of advice。真实写作体裁=建议信。
prompt_cn: 你的同学李华最近沉迷电脑游戏、无法专心学习,向你求助。请用英语给他写一封建议信(约80词),内容包括:① 点明你了解他的问题与感受;② 给出至少两条建议及理由;③ 以鼓励的话收尾。
prompt_en: Your classmate Li Hua spends too much time playing computer games and cannot focus on his studies. Write him a letter of advice (about 80 words). Your letter should: 1) show that you understand his problem and how he feels; 2) give at least two pieces of advice, each with a reason; 3) end with a few words of encouragement.
points: 用称呼开头,点明对方的问题(You wrote that …)
表示理解对方的感受(I understand that you feel …)
给出至少两条建议及理由(I think you should … / Why not … because …)
用鼓励的话和落款收尾(I am sure that … / Best wishes,)
model_essay: Dear Li Hua, You wrote that you spend too much time playing computer games and cannot focus on your studies. I understand that you feel worried. I think you should make a daily schedule and set a fixed time for games. Why not try some new hobbies, such as sports or reading? They can help you relax in a healthier way. I am sure that if you keep trying, you will manage your time much better. Best wishes, Wang Ming
model_translation: 亲爱的李华:你来信说你花太多时间打电脑游戏,无法专心学习。我理解你感到很担心。我认为你应该制定一份每日计划,给游戏设定固定的时间。何不尝试一些新爱好,比如运动或阅读呢?它们能以更健康的方式帮你放松。我相信只要你坚持努力,就能把时间管理得更好。祝好!王明

rubric.criteria: 点明问题、表示理解、给出至少 2 条建议及理由
称呼 / 正文(问题+理解+建议+理由)/ 鼓励结尾 / 落款,顺序合理
句型词汇准确多样,使用建议信常用表达,语法基本无误

required_structure: 指出问题 You wrote that …
表示理解 I understand that you feel …
建议+理由 I think you should … / Why not … because …
鼓励结尾 I am sure that …
